main_topics.reason: The user came to ask whether switching to a different maker of the same medicine and dose was something to worry about, and returned for practical guidance.
The user asked why testing should wait six to eight weeks, whether a recent result counted, and confirmed when to test after the switch.
The user asked what to watch for before the test and said they tend to notice coldness and tiredness quickly.
The user said they were annoyed that the pharmacy switched the brand without explaining the implications.
The user said they would prefer to stay on one brand to avoid uncertainty with future switches.

output.summary: The user asked whether a pharmacy switch to a different maker of their usual levothyroxine was concerning and what to do. The assistant explained the proposed TSH retest timing, signs to monitor, and keeping the same routine; the user also raised frustration about the pharmacy's lack of explanation and a preference for brand consistency. The user said the plan was clear and the answer was exactly what they wanted.
